one_liner: Cloud-based observability and security platform for metrics, logs, traces, monitors, and more.
access_notes: Self-serve 14‑day trial and then a Free tier; you can create API/app keys or PAT/SAT in any org.
mcp_notes: Set Up the Datadog MCP Server: https://docs.datadoghq.com/mcp_server/setup/
blocker_notes: If you want Datadog-hosted OAuth2 flows to authorize on customers’ orgs, you must join the Technology Partner Program and implement OAuth 2.0 for Partners.

evidence.quote: All requests to Datadog’s API must be authenticated. Requests that write data require … an API key. Requests that read data … also require an application key.
Personal Access Tokens (PATs) … do not need to be paired with an API key. They are short‑lived and scoped by default.
When your free trial ends, you can … move to the Free tier.
When you authorize an MCP client, Datadog creates a consent grant … Alternatively, provide a Datadog API key and application key as DD_API_KEY and DD_APPLICATION_KEY HTTP headers.
If your integration uses the API on behalf of mutual customers, you must implement OAuth 2.0 for Partners.

_trail.quote: "Learn how to set up and configure the Datadog MCP Server, which lets you retrieve telemetry insights and manage platform features directly from AI-powered clients."
